<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel><data id="list" expr="[{name: 'first'}]"/></datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <onentry>
      <log expr="list.0"/>
      <log expr="list.0.name"/>
      <assign location="list.0" expr="1"/>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="go" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>
